peers.name: wrangler
peers.description: Run or troubleshoot Wrangler CLI commands in projects that have a wrangler.jsonc, wrangler.json, or wrangler.toml file, including local development, Previews, deployment, and resource management. For new projects and projects without a Wrangler configuration file, use the cf CLI instead.

peers.name: workers-best-practices
peers.description: Cloudflare Workers best practices for production applications. Use when writing, reviewing, or configuring Workers.

peers.name: web-perf
peers.description: Audit, diagnose, or optimize website loading and interaction performance, Core Web Vitals, and Lighthouse performance scores.

peers.name: durable-objects
peers.description: Build, debug, or review Cloudflare Durable Objects code for persistent state and coordination.

en.tagline: Choose Cloudflare products for a given need
en.summary: The cloudflare skill helps an agent turn a user's goal into a set of Cloudflare products. It maps common needs to products and points to the matching skills or docs. When a Cloudflare-proxied site shows an error page, it also helps decide whether to fix the Cloudflare configuration or the origin.
problem: Users often describe a need, such as storing uploads, running background jobs, or searching documents, without knowing which Cloudflare product fits. The platform has many products, and some have overlapping uses.

With this skill, the agent starts from the user's goal and recommends a small set of products, explaining the role of each. It also decides between the cf CLI and Wrangler based on the project, then loads the relevant skill or docs before implementing.
fit: Choosing products for a new app, API, or AI agent
Comparing similar products, such as D1 and Durable Objects for stored data
Diagnosing a 52x, 1xxx, or 403 error on a Cloudflare-proxied site
unfit: Looking up API details for a product you have already chosen; the skill points to product docs rather than replacing them
Hosting decisions that do not involve Cloudflare
steps: Check the project for Wrangler config files to decide between the cf CLI and Wrangler.
Find the row in the need-to-product map that is closest to the user's goal.
Recommend a small set of products and explain why each one fits.
Compare similar products by the deciding requirement, such as data shape, consistency, or coordination.
Load the named product skill if it is installed, or follow the linked product docs.
On a Cloudflare error page, decide whether to fix the Cloudflare configuration or the origin.

zh.tagline: 按需求选择 Cloudflare 产品
zh.summary: cloudflare 技能帮助智能体把用户的目标对应到具体的 Cloudflare 产品，并指向相应的技能或文档。遇到 Cloudflare 代理站点的错误页面时，它还能判断应修改 Cloudflare 配置，还是检查源站。
problem: 用户常常只描述需求，例如存储上传文件、运行后台任务或搜索文档，却不清楚该用哪个 Cloudflare 产品。产品数量多，部分功能又有重叠。
使用该技能后，智能体先从用户目标出发，推荐一组精简的产品并说明各自的作用。它会根据项目类型决定使用 cf 还是 Wrangler，再加载相关技能或文档开始实现。
fit: 为新应用、API 或 AI 智能体选择产品
在相近产品之间做选择，例如用于存储数据的 D1 与 Durable Objects
排查 Cloudflare 代理站点上的 52x、1xxx 或 403 错误
unfit: 只需查阅已选定产品的 API 细节；该技能指向产品文档，并不替代文档
与 Cloudflare 无关的托管选型
steps: 检查项目中是否有 Wrangler 配置文件，据此选择 cf 或 Wrangler。
在需求与产品对应表中，找到最接近用户目标的一行。
推荐一组精简的产品，并说明每个产品为何适合。
按决定性要求比较相近产品，例如数据结构、一致性或协调需求。
如已安装对应的产品技能，则加载它；否则查阅链接的产品文档。
遇到 Cloudflare 错误页面时，判断应修改 Cloudflare 配置还是检查源站。
